card.name: Needle gauge and injection spacing units
card.fires_on: The unit word right after a number in injection instructions, mainly "gauge" in needle sizes, also "cm" for spacing between injection sites and "minutes" for timing of an injection.

modes.label: Needle gauge
modes.description: The word gauge (or its ending) after a needle size number.
modes.example: using a 22<< gauge>> or larger catheter or needle.·

modes.label: Injection timing and spacing
modes.description: Minutes or cm after a number when describing how fast or how far apart to inject.
modes.example: TALVEY injections should be at least 2<< cm>> apart.
